name: Creamy Tuscan Garlic Butter Chicken
steps: Season chicken cutlets with salt, pepper, and Italian herbs.
Heat olive oil and 1 tbsp butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Sear chicken 5-6 mins per side until golden brown and cooked through. Transfer to a plate.
In the same skillet, melt remaining butter. Add minced garlic and sun-dried tomatoes; sauté for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in chicken broth and heavy cream. Bring to a gentle simmer, scraping up any browned bits.
Stir in grated Parmesan until melted. Add fresh spinach and let wilt for 2 minutes.
Return chicken cutlets to the pan, spooning the rich creamy sauce over them. Garnish with fresh herbs and serve warm.

name: Authentic Neapolitan Margherita Pizza
steps: Preheat oven with pizza stone to highest setting (500°F / 260°C) for 45 minutes.
Gently stretch dough from center outwards onto parchment or a floured peel, leaving a puffy 1-inch crust edge.
Spread crushed tomatoes evenly over the base.
Tear fresh mozzarella into chunks and distribute evenly. Drizzle with olive oil and sea salt.
Bake for 8-10 minutes until crust is blistered and cheese is bubbling.
Top with fresh basil leaves immediately after baking, slice, and enjoy hot.

name: 15-Minute Spicy Garlic Sesame Ramen
steps: Boil ramen noodles for 3 minutes. Drain and place in serving bowl.
In a heatproof bowl, add minced garlic, chopped scallion whites, chili flakes, and sesame seeds.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a small pan until smoking hot. Pour hot oil carefully over the garlic and chili to sizzle aromatics.
Stir in soy sauce and sesame oil to make a glossy sauce.
Toss hot noodles into the spicy garlic sesame sauce until well coated.
Top with a soft-boiled egg, scallion greens, and extra sesame seeds.

name: Fresh Mexican Street Tacos (Carne Asada)
steps: Marinate steak in lime juice, minced garlic, cumin, salt, and oil for at least 30 minutes.
Grill or sear steak in a smoking hot skillet for 4-5 mins per side. Rest for 5 mins, then dice into small cubes.
Warm corn tortillas over an open flame or dry pan until soft and lightly charred.
Stack double tortillas, load with grilled steak cubes, and top with diced onions and chopped cilantro.
Drizzle with tangy salsa verde and serve with fresh lime wedges.

name: Velvety Paneer Butter Masala
steps: Lightly pan-fry paneer cubes in 1 tbsp butter until golden. Soak in warm water to keep tender.
In a pan, cook onions, ginger, and garlic in butter until soft and golden.
Add tomato puree, chili powder, coriander, and turmeric. Cook until oil separates (10 mins).
Blend tomato mixture with cashew cream for a silky restaurant gravy.
Simmer sauce, stir in paneer cubes, crushed fenugreek leaves, and garam masala.
Swirl in heavy cream, garnish with fresh cilantro, and serve with warm naan or rice.

name: Mediterranean Quinoa Salad Bowl
steps: Cook rinsed quinoa in 2 cups water or broth for 15 minutes. Let cool.
In a small bowl, whisk olive oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Dice cucumber, halve tomatoes, and drain chickpeas.
In serving bowls, layer cooked quinoa, chickpeas, cucumber, tomatoes, olives, and red onion.
Drizzle zesty lemon dressing over the bowl, crumble feta cheese on top, and sprinkle with parsley.

name: Avocado & Runny Poached Egg Sourdough Toast
steps: Toast thick slice of sourdough bread until golden and crisp.
Mash ripe avocado with lemon juice, salt, and cracked black pepper.
Simmer water with 1 tbsp vinegar in a small pot. Create a whirlpool and gently drop in egg. Poach for 3 minutes.
Spread mashed avocado generously over toasted sourdough.
Place warm poached egg on top. Garnish with red chili flakes, flaky salt, and a drizzle of olive oil.

name: Warm Molten Dark Chocolate Lava Cake
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F (218°C). Grease two ramekins and dust with cocoa powder.
Melt dark chocolate and butter together until completely smooth.
Whisk in powdered sugar, 2 whole eggs + 1 yolk, and vanilla extract until glossy.
Fold in flour and a pinch of salt just until combined.
Pour batter into prepared ramekins. Bake for 12 minutes until edges are set but center jiggles.
Invert gently onto plates, dust with powdered sugar, and serve warm with vanilla ice cream.

name: Crispy Teriyaki Salmon Rice Bowl
steps: Whisk soy sauce, honey, minced garlic, and grated ginger in a bowl to make teriyaki sauce.
Pat salmon skin very dry with paper towels and season with salt.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a skillet. Sear salmon skin-side down for 5-6 mins until skin is super crisp.
Flip salmon, pour teriyaki sauce into the pan, and spoon over salmon for 2-3 mins until glazed.
Serve glazed salmon over steamed jasmine rice with sliced cucumbers and edamame.
Garnish with toasted sesame seeds and sliced green onions.

name: Aromatic Thai Coconut Green Curry
steps: Heat 1 tbsp coconut oil in a pan. Pan-fry tofu or chicken until lightly browned, then set aside.
Fry green curry paste in coconut cream for 2 minutes until fragrant and oil separates.
Pour in remainder of coconut milk and bring to a gentle simmer.
Add sliced bell peppers and snap peas. Cook for 5 minutes until tender-crisp.
Season with soy sauce, lime juice, and return cooked tofu/chicken to pan.
Turn off heat, stir in fresh Thai basil leaves, and serve hot over jasmine rice.

name: Classic Golden French Omelette
steps: Whisk 3 eggs vigorously with a pinch of salt and pepper until uniform and slightly frothy.
Melt butter in a non-stick skillet over medium-low heat until foamy but not browned.
Pour in eggs and shake pan while stirring quickly with a spatula until soft curds form.
Smooth curds into an even layer, sprinkle cheese and chopped chives across the center.
Roll omelette gently onto itself and slide onto a warm plate. Brush top with a touch of butter.

name: Loaded Vegetarian Black Bean Quesadilla
steps: In a small bowl, mix rinsed black beans with corn, diced peppers, cumin, salt, and pepper.
Place tortilla on a dry skillet over medium heat. Cover half with cheese, the bean mixture, and more cheese.
Fold tortilla in half over the filling.
Cook 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown, crispy, and the cheese is fully melted.
Slice into wedges and serve with salsa, guacamole, and sour cream.
